content:
Jimmy Fallon, host of the program "The Tonight Show," on Tuesday dismissed President Trump's newly launched artificial intelligence website, but still compared it to a popular candy. (See video below.)

The talk show host mentioned that the website "merges thousands of government websites into one."

Fallon, speaking in a Russian accent, joked: "The Russian hackers said, 'This thing saves us a lot of time, thank you.'" "'Thanks a lot.'"

The comedian also said: "That's right, everyone is afraid of AI, and no one trusts the federal government, so Trump thought, 'Why not combine the two, it's like a doomsday Reese's Peanut Butter Cup.'"

As the chocolate's slogan goes, Fallon is probably #NotSorry about his own joke.

Fallon can criticize however he wants, but at least America.gov admits Trump lost the 2020 election, which is different from the man behind it.
